messages:
sara: AcmeCorp on phone — production API returning 500s and very high latency. They say traffic is pinned to us-east but traces show requests hitting eu-west. Trace id=acme-0xabc123. Escalating. @devon @kai

devon: On it. Can you paste raw req/resp headers + exact curl you used? Also which endpoint/path?

acme-support: Minimal repro from their side:

curl -v \\n  -H 'Host: api.acme.com' \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \\n  -H 'X-Redwood-Region: us-east' \\n  'https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate'

Response (headers trimmed):
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
x-request-id: req-98765
X-Served-Region: eu-west
Trace: acme-0xabc123
Latency: ~260ms

They believe it should be served from us-east and latency to eu-west is spiking their SLA.

kai: Noted — we had an Envoy/gateway deploy ~15m ago (v2.3.1). Possible that L7 routing / header mutation changed. Asking for ingress access logs for that trace.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: deployed envoy/gateway v2.3.1 to prod at 1740536700 (CI pipeline)

devon: Can you paste the virtual host / route config for api.acme.com? My hunch: a host_rewrite or prefix_rewrite for failover is rewriting :authority and Envoy's header mutation filter is clobbering X-Redwood-Region.

kai: Quick snippet from the active route table (redacted):
```virtual_hosts:
  - name: api_acme
    domains: ["api.acme.com"]
    routes:
      - match: { prefix: "/v1" }
        route:
          cluster: cluster_us_east
          host_rewrite_literal: "eu-west.internal"
          request_headers_to_add:
            - header: { key: X-Served-Region, value: eu-west }
```

devon: Bingo — host_rewrite_literal + request_headers_to_add is the issue. On failover we were rewriting the host and proactively stamping X-Served-Region which triggers downstream behavior and also causes downstream systems to think the request originated in eu-west. That also seems to flip our X-Redwood-Region header due to a header sanitizer filter ordering bug. Repro steps: 1) send X-Redwood-Region: us-east 2) trigger failover route 3) observe X-Served-Region: eu-west and X-Redwood-Region missing/replaced.

sara: Customer asks for ETA + mitigation now. Can we do a quick rollback of the envoy change or apply a header-preserve rule for that customer? Also need their logs for last 30m for billing/regression.

kai: I'll open an incident PR. Temporary mitigation: add header_to_add with keep_existing: true for X-Redwood-Region so it isn't clobbered, and remove host_rewrite_literal from the failover route. Rolling change as canary to 1% first.

acme-support: :thumbsup: Also loop in billing — they're worried about cross-region egress charges while this misrouting is happening.

devon: Assigned — I'll coordinate rollback/patch. Will update the ticket once rollback is live and share exact diff.

sara: Thanks — keeping customer updated. Follow-ups: devon (rollback + patch), kai (inc PR + canary), acme-support (collect last-30m logs & billing contact).
